summary: Implemented the SHACL path parser. Added rdflib/extras/shacl.py with parse_shacl_path(shapes_graph, path_identifier) and SHACLPathError, following the seven-step workflow in the spec. Added test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py with a module-scoped Turtle fixture, a parametrized valid/invalid test, and a separate test for None, a plain string, and a Literal. The new tests and test/test_path.py pass together (42 passed) under the shared venv. Not verified: mypy, black, and isort are not installed in the venv, so the type-ignore placements and import order were checked by reading only. Nothing was committed, and no core modules, __init__ files, or dependency files were changed.
